description: Source code for e2sm_kpm ASN.1 packer, including functions for handling E2SM action definitions, control requests/responses, event trigger definitions, and RAN function descriptions, specific to the KPM (Key Performance Metrics) service model.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_asn1_packer
classes.description: Class responsible for packing and unpacking E2SM KPM ASN.1 messages, including handling action definitions, control requests/responses, event triggers, and RAN function descriptions.

methods.name: handle_packed_e2sm_action_definition
methods.description: Unpacks a packed E2SM KPM action definition from a byte buffer.

methods.name: handle_packed_ric_control_request
methods.description: Handles a packed RIC control request; currently logs failure and returns empty request.

methods.name: pack_ric_control_response
methods.description: Creates a RIC control response; currently logs failure and returns empty response.

methods.name: handle_packed_event_trigger_definition
methods.description: Unpacks a packed event trigger definition and sets report type and period.

methods.name: pack_ran_function_description
methods.description: Creates a packed RAN function description including supported metrics and style types.
